title: Define accountability and data-responsibility roles for components
requirements:
- Define accountability across the LHR service, contributors and stewards
- Name owners, stewards and authorities rather than leaving governance outside the architecture
- Define authoritative source, accountable authority, custodian, steward, operator and contributor
- Name an accountable holder for shared objects with no single source system
- Use accountability, stewardship and lawful processing concepts
- Require contributor agreements, onboarding and data-quality monitoring with remediation
- Use these terms consistently in place of undefined 'owns' and 'stewards'
